conviction_note: A small long lean (p_up 54 on an 11-point absolute move). The only company bar is management's own: Q3 GMV growth above Q2's 18.9%, against a soft Q3 2025 comparison (GMV -2.3%). The ADS has since lost about half its value with no 6-K or news, to roughly 1.2x the June cash balance. Against that, this name has sold or ignored its good prints (Q2's +21% pre-market closed flat, Q1 fell 11% the next day), and October's PMI fell to 49.3 just as the Q4 commentary lands. The findings sum to +1.1 and the scaled number is +0.88; they agree in sign and roughly in size.
bar: Company guide only. From the Q2 2026 call (2026-08-21): Q3 GMV growth to accelerate beyond Q2's 18.9%, which implies Q3 GMV above about RMB3,118m against Q3 2025's RMB2,622.9m (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1862044/000110465925114332/tm2531736d1_ex99-1.htm). Also from that call: FY2026 GMV growth of 15-20%, FY2026 profitability, H2 profitability 'improving more meaningfully', and the international business profitable in H2 (https://www.mitrade.com/insights/news/live-news/article-0-2022629-20260822; https://finviz.com/news/384440/zkh-group-limited-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results). I found no sourced Q3 revenue or EPS consensus. The only street figures are about three analysts with a ~$4.27 target set at much higher prices (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/ZKH) and a stale FY consensus dated April (Seeking Alpha, EPS 0.07). So the street bar is unsourced, and every finding that depends on a beat or miss is capped small. print_vs_bar_pct is measured against the GMV guide, with Q3 GMV growth estimated at about 20%.
positioning_check: Short interest is negligible: about 13.1k ADS short, 0.0% of float, days to cover 1.0, up 25.5% on the prior period and down 67% since Nov 2025 (https://www.stocktitan.net/overview/zkh/, page read 2026-11-17). There is no short to squeeze. The baseline shows no options market (no skew and no implied move). Tape: spot $1.485, -16.1% over 20 days, +10% over 5 days, -60.8% from the 52-week high, +21.7% off the 52-week low, 20-day realised vol 94.9%, average volume 186k ADS. On Yahoo daily bars the ADS fell from $2.83 (2026-10-01) to $1.22 (2026-11-11) on ordinary volume, with no 6-K, no news, and only a Schedule 13G/A from FIL (10.0% of Class A at 2026-09-30, up from 6.0% at 2025-12-31). It jumped +14% on 2026-11-16 ($1.29 to $1.47) with no news found.

findings.finding: Management guided Q3 2026 GMV growth above Q2's 18.9% (FY 15-20%) and H2 profitability 'improving more meaningfully'. The Q3 comparison is soft: Q3 2025 GMV RMB2,622.9m (-2.3% YoY), operating loss RMB32.3m, non-GAAP net loss RMB14.1m. Q2 2026 already showed GMV +18.9% (ZKH platform +22.9%, marketplace +50.7%), the first operating profit (RMB4.0m) and adjusted net profit of RMB38.5m. A Q3 at roughly 20% GMV growth with an operating profit of a few tens of millions of RMB is the base case, and it lands inside the guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: From Yahoo daily closes: Q2 2026 (2026-08-21) traded +21% pre-market on the first operating profit and closed flat, $2.90 to $2.90 on 5.1M ADS, then +4.5% the next day. Q1 2026 (2026-05-21, GMV +12.9%, first Q1 adjusted profit): -0.7% on the day, then -11% the next. Q4 2025 (2026-03-19): -28.7% ($3.28 to $2.34), then +24.8% the next day. Q3 2025 (2025-11-20): +1.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: The guide is public, so the base case itself is not news. But the ADS fell from $2.90 when the guide was given to $1.485 with no company news. Had the market believed in a profitable, ~20%-growing H2, the ADS would not trade near 1.2x June cash. The low price says the market doubts delivery, or there is a seller with no view on the quarter.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 base from the company's own 6-K exhibit (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1862044/000110465925114332/tm2531736d1_ex99-1.htm). Q2 2026 figures from the Q2 press release (https://finviz.com/news/384440/zkh-group-limited-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results). Both are company documents, the same source family as the guide.

findings.finding: The balance sheet nearly covers the market cap, and the buyback has room. At June 30, 2026 the company held RMB1.67bn (US$246.5m) of cash, restricted cash and short-term investments, against a market cap of about $290m at $1.485 (about 197m ADS, from a $261.9m cap at $1.33). It had bought back only 2.49m ADS for $7.67m of a $50m program extended to 2027-06-13. The ~$42m left is about 14% of the ADS at today's price, and the Q3 release normally updates execution.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction to a buyback update on this name. The Q2 release carried a buyback update and the stock closed flat that day.
findings.why_not_priced: The cash figure is public, but it was reported when the ADS was at $2.90. If the market trusted it net of burn, the stock would not have fallen to about 1.2x cash. Whether management bought heavily at $1.2-2.0 in Q3/Q4 is not public until the release.
findings.independence: Market cap at $1.33 ($261.89m) from https://www.tickertape.in/us-stocks/zkh-group-limited-ZKH. Shares the Q2 press release with the cash-burn finding below, which is the counterweight and is filed separately on purpose.

findings.finding: Cash burn and a shrinking customer base, the quality counterweight. Q2 operating cash flow was -RMB122.4m (-RMB110.7m a year earlier), H1 -RMB156m. Cash plus short-term investments fell 13% from RMB1.92bn at 2025-12-31 to RMB1.67bn. Q2 customers fell 1.7% YoY to 73,547. If Q3 shows negative operating cash flow again, profit quality will be the bear's line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 release carried the same cash outflow and customer decline, and the day closed flat.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the same numbers sat in Q2 and the stock has since halved. Filed because a third quarter of burn would test the 'cash backstop' reading in the finding above.
findings.independence: Same Q2 press release as the capital-return finding (https://finviz.com/news/384440/zkh-group-limited-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results). It is one document read two ways, sized net.

findings.finding: This ADS sells its good prints. Q2 2026's first operating profit traded +21% pre-market and closed exactly flat ($2.90 to $2.90) on 5.12M ADS, about 50x normal volume. After that, with no 6-K or news, the ADS fell 45% in October ($2.83 on 10-01 to $1.52 on 10-29) and reached $1.22 on 11-11. The October fall is worth 0 as evidence of overreaction. The filed fact is that a seller absorbed a strong print, and that kind of overhang can cap a good Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: +21% pre-market faded to 0% at the close. Q1 2026: -0.7% then -11%. Q4 2025: -28.7% then +24.8%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the drawdown is in the spot. What is not visible is whether the seller behind the Q2 fade and the October slide has finished. The +14% on 11-16 with no news hints that it may have, which is why this is small.
findings.independence: The Q2 +21% pre-market figure is in https://finviz.com/news/384511/zkh-group-shares-surge-21-after-company-reaches-operating-profitability-for-first-time. No news cause for October was found on itiger's ZKH news feed (https://www-web.itiger.com/stock/ZKH/news) or in the EDGAR submissions list (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001862044.json).

findings.finding: Mixed macro for MRO demand, with the risk on the Q4 commentary. China's industrial output rose 5.5% YoY in September (5.2% in August) and the September manufacturing PMI was 50.1. But Jan-Sep fixed-asset investment fell 7.2%, manufacturing FAI fell 2.1%, and the October official PMI dropped to 49.3 against 50.0 expected. The Q3 GMV line is roughly neutral; the risk is a cautious Q4 tone from management.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No usable history. Q4 2025's -28.7% day came with a forward outlook (Q1 double-digit GMV, FY profitability) and was reversed +24.8% the next day.
findings.why_not_priced: Macro data is public, and it is a proxy: neither the company nor a direct counterparty has confirmed the transmission. Q2 accelerated while FAI was already falling, so the link is weak.
findings.independence: September industrial output: https://www.stats.gov.cn/english/PressRelease/202610/t20261020_1965665.html. FAI: https://www.stats.gov.cn/english/PressRelease/202610/t20261020_1965664.html (manufacturing FAI per https://www.steelorbis.com/steel-news/latest-news/chinas-fai-decreases-by-72-percent-in-january-september-2026-1484987.htm). All three are proxies.

findings.finding: Peer read-through: JD Industrials (7618.HK), China's largest industrial MRO e-commerce player, grew H1 2026 revenue 27.4% (product sales +28.2%) and Q1 26 25.3%, with key-account customers up from ~11k to ~13k. Online MRO demand was healthy through June. It is also the main competitor taking share from large-enterprise accounts.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since August and reported before ZKH's own Q2, so largely priced. No Q3 figure from JD Industrials was found, so the read-through is stale.
findings.independence: Summary at https://www.itiger.com/news/1104457368. This is a peer with no direct link to ZKH's quarter.

findings.finding: FIL Limited/Pandanus raised its stake from 266.8m Class A shares (6.0%) at 2025-12-31 to 444.6m (10.0%) at 2026-09-30, per a Schedule 13G/A filed 2026-11-05. A long-only holder was accumulating through Q3, before the October slide.
findings.why_not_priced: Filed after the slide, its date is Sep 30, and it says nothing about October. It is weak evidence that the October seller was not FIL.

findings.finding: On 2026-11-02 ZKH's AI subsidiary LingLong launched LingLong Insight 1.0 with Intel, a 4B-parameter edge multimodal model for goods-receipt verification. It may feature as an AI narrative on the call; no revenue was disclosed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Stocktitan ties a +1.22% day to the announcement; the ADS then fell to $1.22 by 11-11.
findings.why_not_priced: Public, and the market shrugged at it; filed for completeness.

findings.finding: Director Han Yunjie sold ADS from vested RSUs: a Form 144 for 285,714 ADS (~$0.83m, approximate sale 2026-09-03) and Form 4 sales of 19,226 ADS each at $2.96 (09-09) and $2.92 (09-11).
findings.why_not_priced: Small, routine sales of vested RSUs, public since September. Filed for completeness.

baseline_tension: There is no option skew to cut against. The long lean runs against the 20-day run-up (-16%) and the 52-week trend, but it agrees with the latest 5-day bounce (+10%) and with a near-cash valuation. The reaction history of fading good prints argues against it, and that is why p_up sits only 4 points above 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 / core table (the finding lands inside the company guide): the Q3 GMV/profit finding cut from +1.5 to +1.0.
Lesson 5 (an unexplained microcap drawdown is worth 0): the overhang finding cut from -1.0 to -0.5. Only the sourced Q2 pre-market-to-close fade still carries weight.
Lesson 1 (this name sells its beats): p_up moved from 55 to 54. Scaled number from +1.1 to +0.88.
Lessons 4, 7, 8 and 9 changed nothing: no financing event, short interest negligible and checked, no confirmed unpriced company number, and the peer finding is already small.
